description: This Java class is an integration test for loan fraud functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It tests the ability to mark loans as fraud, verify the status, approve loans, disburse funds, and toggle the 'fraud' flag through API calls.

classes.name: LoanAccountFraudTest
classes.description: An integration test class for verifying the 'fraud' flag functionality on loans, including marking as fraud, unmarking, approval, disbursement, and status checks.
